**irr 50（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　『Furthermore, GCU has the right to terminate the Master Services Agreement after July 1, 2025 upon at least eighteen (18) months prior written notice, and, upon the termination or expiration of the Master Services Agreement, GCU is not required to continue using us as the provider of the services thereunder.』（Item 1A Risk Factors「Risks Related to Our Relationship with GCU」）——売上の89.5%を占める顧客に、無条件の離脱権と『継続利用の義務なし』が明記されている＝随時解約可（検問4）　『Our dependence on our most significant university partner, with 89.5 % and 88.9 % of total service revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, subjects us to the risk that declines in our customers’ operations would result in a sustained reduction in service revenue for the Company.』（Item 8 注記（顧客集中）／Segment Information直前）——射程の実数。摩擦を論じる対象がほぼGCU 1社に収束することを示す　『In addition, colleges and universities may choose to continue using or to develop their own solutions in-house, rather than pay for our solutions.』（Item 1A Risk Factors（競争のリスク要因））——顧客の内製・垂直統合を会社自身が明記（検問4）　『The Company’s Services Agreements have initial terms ranging from 7 - 15 years , subject to renewal options, although certain agreements may give the university partners the right to terminate early if certain conditions are met.』（Item 8 注記2 Revenue Recognition（Services Agreements））——唯一の複数年候補だが、同じ文の後半が早期解約権を認めて逆を言う　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『We have invested more than $350.0 million in the last 17 years in technology which includes the cost to develop systems that automate key processes and enable us to scale these processes to hundreds of thousands of students.』 ／ 『All of GCU’s students, online and ground use this LMS.』　《射程》GCU 1社が総サービス売上の89.5%（FY2025）。その1社が18ヶ月通知で解約でき、かつ解約後の継続利用義務が無いと原本が明記するため、摩擦を主張しうる射程が構造的に存在しない。　《検問と反証の経緯》【70を支える文を探した経緯（実数つき）】原本395,495字を機構語で全数走査: switching cost 0 / switch 0 / lock-in 0 / installed base 0 / renewal rate 0 / retention rate 0 / retrain 0 / learning curve 0 / barrier 0 / 'difficult for our' 0 / 'costly for' 0 / 'replace us' 0 / 'another provider' 0 / 'alternative provider' 0 / 'cost-prohibitive' 0 / 'rely on us' 0 / 'depend on us' 0。'integral' 5件は全て『an integral part of these consolidated financial statements』の定型文。'transition' 11件も顧客の移行は0件（TCFD・ED規則・買収統合・会計基準の移行）。RPOは practical expedient で非開示＝契約済み残高というコミットの実数が存在しない。
【唯一の70候補と、それが落ちた理由】『Services Agreements have initial terms ranging from 7 - 15 years』は複数年の機構に見えるが、(a)同じ文の後半が『although certain agreements may give the university partners the right to terminate early if certain conditions are met』で逆を言う（6146型・引用の後半が逆）、(b)報酬は授業料のレベニューシェアで『dependent upon the number of students attending』＝最低購入義務ゼロ、(c)売上の89.5%を占めるGCUは18ヶ月通知で解約でき『GCU is not required to continue using us as the provider of the services thereunder』と明記。
【反証4】顧客の内製『colleges and universities may choose to continue using or to develop their own solutions in-house』／GCU理事会の受託者義務が当社と乖離しうると自認。
【evidence_gap】台帳の旧根拠は70を支えていない。$350Mは『enable us to scale these processes』＝GCE自身の投資でrep（複製障壁）の領分（6146の『60年以上のテストカット』と同型）。Halo の『All of GCU's students...use this LMS』は顧客が負う費用・時間・義務を一言も述べない（RMD型）。そして旧根拠自身が解約権を引用して『代替不能ではない』と書いており、全文が実質『85ではない』の証明で終わっている＝規約どおり50。
